title: planchonella rostrata
intro: Planchonella rostrata, commonly known as the Australian cherry or cherry plum, is a species of flowering plant in the family Sapotaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include aiding in the treatment of fever, cough, and respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Planchonella rostrata include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities, making it useful in treating wounds and infections.
